units.source_text: 源氏公子自己已经没有气力抱夕颜了。

en.t: Prince Genji himself no longer had the strength to hold Yugao.

units.source_text: 惟光便用褥子把她裹好，抱上车子。

en.t: Koremitsu wrapped her carefully in a bedding quilt and lifted her into the carriage.

units.source_text: 这个人身材小巧，尸体并不给人恶感，却教人觉得可怜。

en.t: She was slight in build, and even in death her body gave no unpleasant impression, but only made one feel pity.

units.source_text: 那褥子很短小，包不了全身，乌黑的头发露在外面。

en.t: The bedding was very short and small, unable to cover her whole body, and her jet-black hair showed outside it.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，伤心惨目，悲怆欲绝。

en.t: When Prince Genji saw this, the sight pierced his heart and eyes, and he was almost overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 他定要跟随前往，目送她化作灰尘。

en.t: He insisted on going along and seeing her through until she was turned to ashes.

units.source_text: 惟光大夫拦阻道：“公子赶快回二条院去，趁现在行人稀少的时候！”

en.t: Koremitsu no Taifu stopped him and said, "My lord, hurry back to Nijo-in now, while there are still few people on the road!"

units.source_text: 他就叫右近上车伴随遗骸，又把马让给源氏公子骑上，

en.t: He had Ukon get into the carriage to accompany the remains, and gave the horse to Prince Genji to ride,

units.source_text: 自己撩起衣裾，徒步跟在车子后面，走出了这院子。

en.t: while he himself lifted the hem of his robe and followed the carriage on foot out of the house.

units.source_text: 他觉得这真是奇怪而意想不到的送殡。

en.t: He felt that this was truly a strange and utterly unexpected funeral procession.

units.source_text: 但是看到公子的悲戚之状，就顾不得自身，径向东山出发了。

en.t: But seeing the prince's grief-stricken state, he forgot about himself and set off straight for Higashiyama.

units.source_text: 源氏公子则仿佛失却知觉，茫茫然地到达了二条院。

en.t: Prince Genji, as if he had lost all awareness, arrived at Nijo-in in a daze.
